headline: Vietnam keeps a firm grip on its monetary policy
summary: Three major central banks raised rates by 0.25 percentage points within about a week as inflation concerns grew. A stronger US dollar is pressuring exchange rates, and Vietnam's growth target and room for exchange-rate management support maintaining its policy.
why: Central bank rate decisions set borrowing costs and currency values, which affect bond yields, equity valuations and capital flows. A stronger dollar tends to pressure emerging-market currencies.
